reader.requirement: DATE-OF-INTEGER's returned value has the form YYYYMMDD (YYYY*10000 + MM*100 + DD), YYYY the Gregorian year, MM its month and DD the day of that month, for every positive integer argument, including years past 9999 at 1985.

edition-consulted.switches: the catalog's D8 edition window (IntroducedIn 85 for the 1989 module rows): the function is admitted at --std 85
DialectBehaviors.IsActive(IntegerDateFormBounded, year): inactive at 85, so BoundIntrinsicCall.IntegerDateFormUnbounded is true
renders `unbounded: true` into the CobolDate call when IntegerDateFormUnbounded

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder, IntrinsicRenderer, CobolDate and DialectBehavior for Edition, DialectLevel, DialectBehavior, IntegerDateForm, ConstructRegistry
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 a year past 9999 yields a nine-digit YYYYMMDD (100000101); from 2002 such an argument is outside the integer date form
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness decomposes one mid value into YYYY, MM and DD; month and year ends (16011231, 16020101, 16010228/16010301) and five-digit years are probed here

probes.expected: proleptic Gregorian count with 1601-01-01 = day 1, every value checked against Python datetime; year 10000 representable at 1985 (the 1989 module bounds the year below only, §1989:A.2.16.3 AR1)
1985 admits years past 9999; 2002 and later end the integer date form at 3,067,671

reader.notes: The month is found by DaysBefore over the leap-aware cumulative table and composed as year*10000 + month*100 + day. Only a year at the 64-bit carrier's limit returns 0, far beyond any argument an 18-digit COBOL-85 item carries.

refuter.evidence: §1989:A.2.12.4 RV2 composes YYYY*10000+MM*100+DD with no bound on YYYY in 1985's argument rule; CobolDate.cs#DateOfInteger returns year*10000+month*100+day and only refuses a year the Int64 cannot hold (unreachable from an 18-digit 1985 argument: the largest 18-digit argument is year ~2.7E15, but a result past 18 digits is already beyond 1985's operand size). rdate.cob at 85: year boundaries 20001231/20010101, 44010101 at seven 400-year cycles, multi-digit years 27395080103 and 3380148080911 (month 08, day 11 checked against Python), round trip INTEGER-OF-DATE(987654320229) -> DATE-OF-INTEGER = 987654320229 (leap Feb 29 in year 98765432). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.12.4 RV2 the text is in RV2.
